summary: John's 7th-great-grand-uncle (son of Daniel and Jeanne); Loyalist.
bio: Son of Daniel Lamoureux and Jeanne Masse, b. 1739; Loyalist who went to New Brunswick, then Scarborough near Toronto; ancestor of the Utah Lamoreauxs incl. Andrew L. Lamoreaux.
sources: A. J. Lamoureux, André Lamoureux, the Huguenot Emigrant, and Family (The Lamoureux Record no. 1, 1919): https://archive.org/details/andrlamoureuxh00lamouoft
